country.name: Comoros
country.officialLocalName: Union des Comores / الاتحاد القمري / Udzima wa Komori
country.jurisdictionNotice: National education authority and island administration responsibilities must be preserved for Ngazidja, Ndzuwani and Mwali. School, vocational and higher-education authorization are separate claims.
country.languagePolicy: Comorian, French and Arabic are official and educationally distinct. Comorian island varieties, Arabic religious education, French-medium curricula and bilingual materials require exact language, script, island, curriculum and community review.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Comorian reviewer and current evidence from the competent ministry, island service, CNIL or institution.

governanceModel.summary: The national ministry responsible for education, higher education, research and professional training sets national policy while island services retain territorial implementation responsibilities. e-Msomo is an operational service, not by itself an authorization register.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve island, prefecture or locality, official school identity, level, sector, language, authorization, operating status and observation date. A bulletin-management record or statistical total is not current authorization.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institution existence, legal creation, exact program authorization, diploma authority, evaluation, professional recognition and regional recognition are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for National Education, Higher Education, Research, Training and Professional Integration
authorities.role: national school, higher-education and training policy within assigned mandates

authorities.name: National education inspectorates and curriculum services
authorities.role: curriculum, pedagogy, examinations and approved-material oversight

authorities.name: Island education administrations
authorities.role: territorial implementation and school-record validation on Ngazidja, Ndzuwani and Mwali

authorities.name: e-Msomo
authorities.role: digital school and bulletin management service

authorities.name: Competent technical and professional training authority
authorities.role: provider and program oversight within the current ministry organization

authorities.name: Competent higher-education directorate
authorities.role: institution and program authorization and diploma oversight

authorities.name: National Commission for Information Technology and Liberties (CNIL)
authorities.role: personal-data protection and treatment control under the 2014 law

curriculum.authority: Competent national curriculum and inspection services
curriculum.title: Official programs by cycle, class, subject and language
curriculum.implementationRule: Ministry news, reform consultations, digital lessons and partnership announcements are not the controlling curriculum. Verify the exact cycle, class, subject, Comorian variety, French or Arabic language, approving instrument, version and effective year.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Orientation law, curriculum, syllabus, approved textbook, religious-education component, teacher guide and external resource are separate layers.

schoolDirectory.authority: National ministry and responsible island education administration
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: e-Msomo supports school-bulletin management, but a verified public unified current directory of every public and private establishment with authorization and operating status was not located. Operational platform presence is not authorization.
requiredRecordFields: public, private, community or confessional sector

educationStatistics.authority: Competent ministry planning and statistics service
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: No current public official statistical yearbook was verified during this review. Every future value must preserve observation year separately from publication date, together with island, cycle, definition, sector and denominator; partner estimates must not be relabeled as official national statistics.

vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: Provider authorization, exact program approval, occupational standard, examination authority, certificate or diploma authority and professional recognition are separate claims. Verify provider, island, site, program, modality, decision and validity.

higherEducation.authorityNotice: A ministry news item or consultation involving a university does not prove institution or program authorization. Verify the legal act, exact institution and program, diploma authority, island and site, modality, current status, validity and any regional or professional recognition separately.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law of 26 June 2014 relating to personal data protection
privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: National Commission for Information Technology and Liberties (CNIL)
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Law of 31 December 2005 relating to child protection and suppression of juvenile delinquency
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Confirm CNIL operational procedures, declarations or authorizations, legal basis, sensitive and biometric data, learner rights, transfers, retention, security and incidents. Current education-sector safeguarding, reporting, referral, consent, participation and emergency procedures must be approved before a real learner pilot.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Comorian, French and Arabic must remain distinct. Shingazidja, Shindzuani and Shimwali varieties, scripts, religious instruction and island contexts require exact curriculum and community review. Automatic translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Comorian education reviewer is named.
National and island education responsibilities are verified.
A verified current unified school authorization directory is documented or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves observation year, island, cycle, definition, sector and publication date.
Every curriculum mapping preserves cycle, subject, language or island variety, instrument, version and effective year.
Every vocational and higher-education claim separately verifies provider or institution, exact program, decision, award, site, status and validity.
CNIL operational procedures and education safeguards are approved before a real learner pilot.
Comorian varieties, French and Arabic resources preserve their distinct contexts.
